acceptanceCriteria: A worked example on a real go.mod bump in the Corvint repository reports call sites, cited upstream symbols and selected tests, or abstains with a reason.
docs/AUTOMATION.md or a new spec states the triggered-step contract and that non-Go ecosystems abstain.
body: Filed 2026-09-27 from the owner's request to research Corvint integrations with large productivity gains. For a module version bump, report the repository's call sites of that module (`corvint impact`), the pinned upstream source for only the used symbols (`corvint depsource`, Go only and experimental) and the selected tests (`corvint affected`). Bumps that touch no used symbol become low-review candidates; the rest carry exact call sites. Runs as a triggered read-only step under docs/AUTOMATION.md with no fetch by Corvint. Advisory only; it never approves or merges. Any productivity gain is a hypothesis until measured; `corvint surprise` and `corvint necessity` supply the measure.
title: ci: dependency-update companion for Renovate and Dependabot PRs from `impact`, `depsource` and `affected`
